key_reasoning.reason: New notice.js modal module plus edits across setup-view.js (reject/notice/retry glue), setup-driver.js (cancelSetup, onScreen, requestCancel), setup-parse.js (detectFailure/FAILURES) and wiring in index.html/renderer.js -- six components, several new abstractions (notice modal, cancellation handshake, failure classifier), but all confined to the single UI layer with no backend/Rust changes.

Extends the already timing-sensitive PTY/xterm parsing path (idle debounce, signature dedup, re-ask vs redraw disambiguation) with new proactive failure detection (onScreen) and a cancel-and-restart handshake; base risk is M (well-established driver pattern, no new integration) bumped to L by the real-time/streaming red flag, mitigated by dedicated fixture-backed tests (authTimeout.json, ollamaNotRunning.json).

12 files changed per diffstat (8 modified: notice.js is new but the rest -- setup-view.js, setup-driver.js, setup-parse.js, index.html, renderer.js -- are edits to existing files, plus 4 new/updated test and fixture files under ui/test/), maps to the 11-15 XL band on the actual-mode file-count table.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from M to L: real-time PTY/terminal streaming timing logic (idle debounce, redraw-vs-reask disambiguation) is central to the change
